title: 假如我是你(第二條件句)

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: I don't know what to do about my job.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: If I were you, I would talk to my boss.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: What would you do if you had more money?

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: If I had more time, I would learn the piano.
